topic: Describing Motion Using Distance, Time, and Speed
key_concepts: A distance-time graph shows how distance changes over time.
Distance and time data can be plotted as points connected by a line.
A straight upward-sloping line on a distance-time graph indicates uniform speed.
A horizontal line on a distance-time graph indicates a stationary object.
A downward-sloping line indicates moving back toward the starting point.
Changes in a distance-time graph line show changes in motion.
Turbo Turtle's motion includes moving at uniform speed, turning back, and moving forward a
Speed can be described by interpreting the slope and direction of a distance-time graph.
